detail: a weathered carved mark consisting of a steep triangular mountain peak intersected horizontally by three parallel drifting fog lines, chiseled deep into raw grey slate without pigment or gilding

evidence.quote: Neutral faction: The Grey Wind. These are tall beings with slate grey skin. They have been seen to walk into mountains and disappear as easily as people walk into the fog.

facts.scale_ref: carved into boundary stones, ruined lintels, and slate tallies
facts.material: unpainted cleft slate or mountain granite
facts.state: ancient, wind-smoothed grooves softened by centuries of mist

note: The boundary and remembrance mark of the Grey Wind, signifying the equivalence of stone and fog, and placed upon the ruins of named civilizations.
